text: Khadija's mum is having her hip replaced on May 14. Khadija is taking the week off to look after her and sounded pretty worn out about it.
Liam lives in Leeds now, in a flat above a bakery. He works for the council in planning.
Remind me to text Javier on Friday at 3pm to see how his knee scan went.
Caught up with Zoe and her sister Phoebe. Phoebe has just started at a law firm in Manchester, and Zoe is still teaching Year 4 at the same school.

Sadia's dad was admitted to hospital last night with chest pains. They're keeping him in until at least Thursday while they run more tests, and her brother Imran is driving down from Leeds tomorrow to sit with him. Sadia is trying to hold it together for her mum, who hasn't left the ward since. I should call her tomorrow morning before her shift and ask if there's anything they need dropping off.
Marisol and Mateo are moving to Bristol on June 3rd. She has a new job at the university there and he's going to work remotely.
Dentist moved to 11/4 at 9:15am. Need to pick up the car from the garage before then.
Lwazi said his brother Thabo had his appendix out on Sunday. He's home now and recovering well, but can't drive for a few weeks.
Gintaras is vegetarian and doesn't drink. His wife Irina is from Vilnius, and they have two girls, both at primary school.
Arjun has his driving test on the 12th at half 9 and is really nervous. Don't forget to wish him luck the night before.

Obi's surgery got cancelled again because they ran out of beds. That's the second time since March. He's been rebooked for July 22 at 8am, but they warned him it could slip again. He was very fed up about it, understandably, and his boss is starting to ask questions about the time off. His girlfriend Shanice is trying to keep him positive.
Noor told me Akira and his partner are expecting their first baby in March. Akira hasn't said anything to me directly yet.
Shanice works night shifts at St Thomas' as a nurse. She lives in Brixton with her cousin.
Picked up a prescription and booked the boiler service for Tuesday afternoon.
Asha had her follow-up with the consultant this morning. All clear, which is such a relief after the last few months. Must send her flowers this week.

Milan's dog Biscuit had an operation on his paw on Monday. Milan was quite shaken, he said it was the first time Biscuit had been put under. The vet wants to see him again on Thursday at 4pm to check the stitches. Ask him on Saturday how Biscuit is getting on.
Ahmed and his wife Nadia are celebrating their tenth anniversary on 9/18. He's planning a surprise weekend in Lisbon and asked me not to mention it to her.
Farid is a structural engineer at Arup. He's originally from Tehran but has lived in Glasgow since he was twelve.
Blessing's mum, Mrs Okafor, is in for a cataract operation on August 5th at 2pm. Blessing is driving her in and staying with her for the evening. Remind me to check in with Blessing the day after.
Nasser started his new role as head of finance at the start of the month. Says it's intense but he's enjoying it.

Sofia's grandmother passed away on Saturday. The funeral is on October 30 at 11am in Seville, and Sofia flies out on the 28th. Her brother Diego is going with her, but her dad can't travel because of his back. She said her abuela basically raised her during the summers. I need to message her before she leaves and maybe send something to the family.
Vera mentioned that her husband works for the fire service and their son is at Edinburgh studying medicine.
Miriam's biopsy results come back Thursday morning. She's trying not to think about it. I'll ring her Thursday evening.
Georgia's hen do in Bath has been called off. She and Tom have split up, apparently it was mutual. She seemed okay but I should take her out for a drink soon.
Adaeze is allergic to nuts and shellfish. Worth remembering for the dinner.
Karim had a minor stroke last week and is at the Royal Free until Monday. His daughter Layla is keeping everyone updated. Must visit him at the weekend, probably Sunday at 2pm when visiting opens.
Imani got into the choir at the cathedral. First rehearsal is next Wednesday at 7pm.
Chioma and her husband live in Peckham with their twins, who are about four. She runs a small catering business from home.
Remind me to ask Liam how his dad's heart surgery went on the 3rd. Liam said it would be a long one, around six hours.
Javier's birthday is on May 2nd. He keeps saying he wants a decent espresso machine.

Long call with Khadija tonight. Her brother Yusuf is back in hospital, this time for an infection after his operation on April 20. Her mum is staying with him most days, and Khadija is covering the school runs for his kids. She's exhausted and said she hasn't slept properly in a week. I should offer to take the kids one afternoon, maybe Thursday after school, and check in with her on Sunday.
Zoe's physio appointment is at 4:30pm tomorrow. She's still on crutches after the ankle surgery.
Mateo's mum, Mrs Gonzalez, is turning seventy on June 21st. There's a family lunch at their place at 1pm. I'm bringing dessert.
Phoebe and Sadia are both doing the half marathon on 4/27. Phoebe's aiming for under two hours, Sadia just wants to finish.
Need to book an eye test and renew my passport before the end of the month.
Lwazi Okafor from work lives in Croydon. He has a cat called Pepper and two older sisters.

Spoke to Arjun after his interview at Google. He thinks it went well, though the system design round threw him a bit. His wife Priya is convinced he's got it. He should hear back by Friday afternoon, and if it's a yes he'd start in January. Text him Friday evening to see if he's heard anything.
Akira and Noor are hosting a housewarming on Saturday the 15th from 6pm. They've finally finished the kitchen.

Irina said her father has early dementia. They're looking at care homes near Kaunas but her mum is resisting it and wants to keep him at home. Irina is flying over on November 8 for a week to visit two places with her sister. She's finding it all very hard and feels guilty being so far away.
Obi Wright, Obi to everyone except his mum, is the new manager at the climbing centre. He used to be a paramedic.
Shanice has a scan at 10am on the 9th and asked if I could come with her. I'm taking the morning off for it.
Don't forget: Asha's son Kiran starts at secondary school on September 4. She's more nervous than he is.
Milan's sister Petra had her baby on Tuesday night, a little girl called Ana. Both doing well. Must get a card and something small for the baby.
Remind me to call Ahmed's dad on Wednesday at noon. He's home from hospital after his bypass and Ahmed asked if I'd check on him while he's away.
Farid and Blessing are getting married on 8/16 at a barn near Stroud. Ceremony is at 2pm and the reception goes on until midnight.
Nasser is on the waiting list for a knee replacement. He's in a lot of pain but still coaching the under-12s on Saturdays.
Sofia lives with her girlfriend Marta in a flat in Hackney. Marta is a vet.

Vera's operation went fine yesterday. She's sore but already bored of the ward and complaining about the food. Her son is visiting this evening after work. They might discharge her Friday morning if her bloods are okay. I should drop off some books and her favourite chocolate before then, probably Thursday at lunchtime.
Weekly shop, then gym at 6. Nothing else on today.
Miriam's daughter Hannah graduates from Durham on July 1st at 10:30am. Miriam, her husband and both grandmothers are going up the night before.
Georgia is a primary school teacher in Hove. Her partner works in IT and they have a rescue greyhound called Wilf.

Adaeze had her gallbladder removed on Monday. Her husband said the surgery went well but she's in quite a bit of pain. Send her a message tomorrow afternoon to see how she's doing, and ask if they need any meals.

Karim's leaving do is on Friday at 5:30pm at the Crown. He's retiring after thirty years at the bank and his wife Samira is coming along for the first hour. Everyone is chipping in for a set of golf clubs. Don't forget to put a tenner in the envelope by Wednesday.
Imani's mum and dad are flying in from Nairobi on December 18 and staying until early January. She's slightly stressed about having them in the flat for that long.
Remind me to ask Chioma whether her dad's MRI on the 7th showed anything.

Gintaras's daughter Ieva broke her arm at gymnastics on Saturday. She has a fracture clinic appointment on Wednesday at 9am. Gintaras is taking her and Irina is covering his shift. Ieva is apparently loving the attention.
Liam and Javier are flatmates again, back in the place on Mill Road. Javier works at the hospital pharmacy, Liam is still freelancing.
Note to self: the clinic called and moved my blood test to 6/11 at 8:40am. No breakfast that morning.

Talked to Zoe, Khadija and Sadia at lunch. Zoe's mum has a hysterectomy on March 3rd and Zoe is staying with her for a fortnight afterwards. Khadija offered to cover her classes. Sadia mentioned her own mum went through the same thing last year and recovered fine. Zoe seemed calmer after hearing that. I should check in with her the week after.
Mateo said Marisol has been offered a permanent contract. They're celebrating at her parents' on Sunday lunchtime.
